title: Generic-point patching for ideals from small-support coherent modules
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\mathcal P$ be a property of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose $\mathcal P(0)$; suppose for every short exact sequence of coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent], $0\to F_1\to F\to F_2\to0$, $\mathcal P(F_1)$ and $\mathcal P(F_2)$ imply $\mathcal P(F)$; and suppose for any coherent $F$ and integer $r\ge1$, $\mathcal P(F^{\oplus r})$ implies $\mathcal P(F)$. Fix a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], with $Z$ integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], and $\xi\in X$ such that $\overline{\{\xi\}}=i(Z)$. Stalks are as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], support as in [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and $\mathfrak m_\xi$ as in [def-weil-residue-field]. Assume that every coherent $Q$ with $\operatorname{Supp}(Q)\subseteq i(Z)$ and $Q_\xi=0$ has $\mathcal P$. Assume there exists a coherent $G$ with $\operatorname{Supp}(G)=i(Z)$ and $\mathfrak m_\xi G_\xi=0$, such that for every quasi-coherent ideal $J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] with $J_\xi=\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$, there is a coherent submodule $G'\subseteq JG$ with $G'_\xi=G_\xi$ and $\mathcal P(G')$. Here $JG$ is the image of ideal multiplication [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk], formed using [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Then for every quasi-coherent ideal $I\subseteq\mathcal O_Z$, represented by $Z.\operatorname{IdealSheafData}$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], $\mathcal P(i_*I)$ holds. The pushforward is the module pushforward [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text: Extension closure and P(0) imply invariance under isomorphisms of coherent modules, using the short exact sequence 0 → 0 → F → G → 0 for F ≅ G. Closed immersions are finite [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-finite]; their sources are locally Noetherian [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft]. Ideal modules on the source and their pushforwards are coherent by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth], [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-kernel-cokernel-locnoeth] and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-coherent].

The generic point η of Z maps to ξ by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-sober] and the closed embedding. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-generic-point-ideal-inclusion] to G: obtain a mono from i_*(I^{⊕r}) into G which is an isomorphism near ξ. Since Supp(G)=i(Z), G_ξ is nonzero, so r≥1 and I is nonzero. For every nonzero ideal I′≤I, its generic stalk inclusion is bijective by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-scheme-ideal-generic-stalk]. Sectionwise pushforward commutes with finite sums. Its composite β:(i_*I′)^{⊕r}→G is a mono, bijective at ξ by naturality [lem-weil-pbc-closed-pushforward-stalks].

The cokernel Q of β is coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-kernel-cokernel-locnoeth], supported in i(Z), and has zero ξ-stalk by [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact]. Set J=Ann(Q), using [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-theoretic-support]. The support of Q is closed [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-module-support-closed] and misses ξ, so Q vanishes on its open complement by [lem-weil-pbc-module-iso-on-stalks]. Thus J is the unit ideal on this complement and has full ξ-stalk. J is quasi-coherent and coherent by the structure-sheaf kernel construction and finite closed pushforward from step 1. The image of multiplication J⊗G→G lies in ker(G→Q)=im β, because J kills Q; use the construction [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] or its stalk image [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. Apply the distinguished-module hypothesis to J. Pull its subobject G′ back along β to a coherent subobject H of (i_*I′)^{⊕r}. It is isomorphic to G′ and therefore has P. Its quotient is coherent, supported in i(Z), and vanishes at ξ by stalk exactness. The hypothesis for small-support modules gives P of the quotient. Extension closure gives P((i_*I′)^{⊕r}), and the positive-sum hypothesis gives P(i_*I′).

For any nonzero ideal I″, take I′=I″∩I. This is quasi-coherent [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-intersection]. On a nonempty affine open, [lem-weil-pbc-integral-scheme-ideal-generic-stalk] supplies nonzero elements of I and I″; their product is nonzero since Z is integral, and lies in the intersection. Step 3 gives P(i_*I′). The mono i_*I′→i_*I″ is bijective at ξ; its coherent cokernel is supported in i(Z) and has zero ξ-stalk [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact]. Apply the small-support hypothesis and extension closure. If I″=0, its pushforward is zero; P(0) and isomorphism invariance give the conclusion.
